SourceRef.description: Where a record or document lives in its home system.

description: One card expense or vendor bill, as the card platform (Ramp) holds it.

accounting_date.description: The date Ramp assigned for the books.

amount_cents.description: Positive is money spent. Negative is a refund or credit.

approvals.description: The steps of the approval chain. An empty list means it was never sent for approval. None means the source could not say, which is not the same thing. None is always written out as null, so it is still None when the record is read back.

document_ids.description: Receipts or invoices attached in Ramp.

paid_date.description: Bill: the day payment left. Card: the settlement date.

raw.description: The record as the source returned it.
raw.title: Raw

spender_id.description: Person.id of the cardholder or requester.
spender_id.title: Spender Id

transaction_date.description: Card: the purchase date. Bill: the invoice date.
